anchors.A.module_submission_date: Date of the modular PMA software module (or amendment) submission. Source: L2-00.02.

anchors.A.sbom_build: Build/version the SBOM states it describes. Source: L2-16.01.

anchors.A.threat_model_version: Version, date and configuration covered by the threat model. Source: L2-14.01.
anchors.A.supported_platforms: Hardware, OS, browser/cloud and peripheral platforms claimed as supported. Source: L2-02.03.
anchors.A.device_support_end: Manufacturer-stated end of support / end of life for the device software. Source: L2-25.07 / L2-24.10.

l2.title: Risk management plan
l2.expectation: Plan states scope/lifecycle phases, responsibilities, review requirements, individual risk acceptability criteria (incl. when probability cannot be estimated), overall residual risk method/criteria, verification activities and post-production activities.
l2.importance_reason: FDA focus items: acceptability criteria and overall residual risk method.

parameters.name: plan_approval_date
parameters.check: must be earlier than the earliest initial risk evaluation date in L2-04.04 (FDA-SW VI.C(1): criteria documented before initial evaluation)

parameters.name: acceptability_criteria_matrix
parameters.check: same matrix must be applied in L2-04.04 and L2-04.06; differing matrices => break

parameters.name: criteria_when_probability_unestimable
parameters.check: required (ISO 14971 4.4 d)); software failure probability default (FDA-SW fn45 worst case =1) noted

parameters.name: overall_residual_risk_method
parameters.check: must be the method used in L2-04.07 (ISO 14971 4.4 e))

parameters.name: responsibility_assignments
parameters.check: approver of risk report must hold assigned authority (ISO 14971 9)

parameters.name: lifecycle_phases_in_scope
parameters.check: must include production/post-production (4.4 g))

l2.currency_rule: FDA-SW VI.C(1): acceptability criteria documented in the plan before the initial risk evaluation of the software under review.

l2.title: Intended use, foreseeable misuse and safety characteristics
l2.expectation: Intended use, reasonably foreseeable misuse and characteristics related to safety are documented.
l2.importance_reason: Input to hazard identification; must match labeling/USE SPECIFICATION.

parameters.name: intended_use_statement_ref
parameters.check: must equal indications in labeling (L1-29) and USE SPECIFICATION (L2-27.01)

parameters.name: foreseeable_misuse_list
parameters.check: intentional misuse (FDA-SW VI.C(2)) must be considered, incl. security-related misuse (cross-ref L2-13.03)

l2.currency_rule: reviewer judgment; no stated rule.

l2.title: Hazards, sequences of events and hazardous situations (software incl.)
l2.expectation: Known/foreseeable hazards with causes, software items contributing, sequences of events and resulting hazardous situations are identified, including SOUP anomaly-related causes.
l2.importance_reason: Root of the hazard→control→verification chain.

parameters.name: hazard_id
parameters.check: unique; every hazard must trace to >=1 hazardous_situation (ISO 14971 4.5)

parameters.name: hazardous_situation_id
parameters.check: must trace to >=1 risk_control or an explicit acceptance at initial evaluation

parameters.name: contributing_software_item_ids
parameters.check: each must exist in architecture (L2-06.02) (IEC 62304 7.1.1)

parameters.name: soup_anomaly_cause_flag
parameters.check: if true, must link to SOUP anomaly review (L2-12.04) (IEC 62304 7.1.3)

parameters.name: security_origin_flag
parameters.check: if true, must link to transferred security risk (L2-15.05)

parameters.name: harm_and_severity
parameters.check: severity scale from plan; must match severity used in URRA (L2-27.03) for use-related hazards

parameters.name: probability_basis
parameters.check: if software failure probability <1 used, rationale required (FDA-SW fn45)

l2.currency_rule: reviewer judgment; risk analysis maintained throughout lifecycle (ISO 14971 10.4).

l2.title: Initial risk estimation and evaluation
l2.expectation: Each hazardous situation has an estimated risk and an acceptability decision using the plan's criteria.
l2.importance_reason: Establishes which situations need controls.

parameters.name: initial_severity
parameters.check: scale per plan

parameters.name: initial_probability
parameters.check: or 'not estimable' per plan rule

parameters.name: initial_acceptability
parameters.check: acceptable|not acceptable; recomputed from matrix must equal stated value

parameters.name: evaluation_date
parameters.check: must be later than plan_approval_date (L2-04.01)

l2.currency_rule: FDA-SW VI.C(1) ordering: criteria precede evaluation.

l2.title: Risk control measures and their verification (implementation and effectiveness)
l2.expectation: Each control is classified (design/protective/information), traced to SRS/SDS and to tests or other evidence verifying implementation and, separately, effectiveness; new risks from controls assessed.
l2.importance_reason: Core FDA ask: verification of implementation AND effectiveness via traceability.

parameters.name: risk_control_id
parameters.check: unique

parameters.name: control_type
parameters.check: inherent safety by design|protective measure|information for safety (priority order per ISO 14971 7.1)

parameters.name: implementing_requirement_ids
parameters.check: each must exist in SRS (L2-05.02) and be flagged safety-related (IEC 62304 5.2.3)

parameters.name: implementing_design_ids
parameters.check: Enhanced: each must exist in SDS (L2-07.01)

parameters.name: implementation_verification_test_ids
parameters.check: each must exist as test_case with a passing test_run on A.release_build_id or bridged build

parameters.name: effectiveness_verification_ref
parameters.check: distinct evidence that risk is reduced (validation, HF test, analysis); may not be the implementation test alone unless relationship justified (ISO 14971 7.2 Note 3)

parameters.name: information_for_safety_label_ref
parameters.check: if control_type=information, must resolve to labeling section (L1-29) and HF evaluation (L2-27.06)

parameters.name: new_risks_from_control_assessed
parameters.check: must be true (ISO 14971 7.5)

parameters.name: hazard_ids
parameters.check: each must exist in L2-04.03 (hazard_id or hazardous_situation_id)

l2.currency_rule: ISO 14971 7.2: verification of implementation and effectiveness recorded; evidence must apply to the released configuration (FDA-SW VI.H system test report for candidate release version).

l2.title: Residual risk evaluation and benefit-risk
l2.expectation: Residual risk per hazardous situation is evaluated against plan criteria; unacceptable residual risks have benefit-risk analysis.
l2.importance_reason: Defines what risk remains and whether it is accepted on benefit grounds.

parameters.name: residual_acceptability
parameters.check: recomputed from plan matrix must equal stated value

parameters.name: benefit_risk_ref
parameters.check: required if residual_acceptability=not acceptable (ISO 14971 7.4)

parameters.name: open_anomaly_ids_affecting
parameters.check: each unresolved anomaly with risk impact (L2-11.01) must be reflected here

l2.currency_rule: reviewer judgment; must reflect final controls and unresolved anomalies at release.

l2.title: Overall residual risk and disclosure
l2.expectation: Overall residual risk evaluated with the plan's method; significant residual risks disclosed in accompanying documentation.
l2.importance_reason: Decision-level conclusion for the module.

parameters.name: overall_residual_risk_conclusion
parameters.check: acceptable|not acceptable

parameters.name: method_used
parameters.check: must equal overall_residual_risk_method in plan (L2-04.01)

parameters.name: disclosed_residual_risks
parameters.check: each must appear in labeling (L1-29) (ISO 14971 8)

parameters.name: evaluation_date
parameters.check: must be after last risk_control verification date and after last anomaly disposition date (CC-12)

l2.currency_rule: ISO 14971 8: after all controls implemented and verified.

l2.title: Risk management report / review
l2.expectation: Report shows plan implemented, overall residual risk acceptable, production/post-production methods in place, reviewed by assigned persons.
l2.importance_reason: FDA-SW VI.C(3) recommended submission item.

parameters.name: report_version_date
parameters.check: defines A.risk_file_version

parameters.name: report_date
parameters.check: must be on or after A.release_date's prerequisites: after last anomaly disposition (L2-11.01) and before A.module_submission_date; ISO 14971 9 'prior to release for commercial distribution'

parameters.name: reviewers_and_authority
parameters.check: must match responsibilities in plan (ISO 14971 9)

parameters.name: software_version_covered
parameters.check: must equal A.proposed_version

parameters.name: post_production_methods_ref
parameters.check: must align with L2-04.09 and cyber management plan (L1-25)

l2.currency_rule: ISO 14971 9: review prior to release for commercial distribution; report must reflect the proposed release.

l2.title: Production and post-production information system
l2.expectation: System to collect and review production/post-production information, including feedback into risk file.
l2.importance_reason: Mostly QMS; matters for PMA conditions and cyber monitoring linkage.

parameters.name: information_sources
parameters.check: should include complaint, vulnerability and SOUP-supplier sources (link L2-25.02)

l2.currency_rule: ISO 14971 10: ongoing; no premarket recency rule.
